toegepas.voor: By 'n oase is daar water en daar groei
toegepas.na: By 'n oase is daar water, en daar groei
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two main clauses ('daar is water' / 'daar groei bome').
toegepas.rede_keurder: Both clauses have their own subject and verb, so the AWS 2017 comma is required and nothing else changes.

toegepas.voor: deur die Sahara en baie mense boer
toegepas.na: deur die Sahara, en baie mense boer
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two main clauses ('die Nyl vloei' / 'baie mense boer').
toegepas.rede_keurder: Two full sentences joined by 'en' take the comma; the qualifier 'baie' is untouched.

toegepas.voor: wat hulle kan afhaal en saamneem
toegepas.na: wat hulle kan afslaan en saamneem
toegepas.rede_vinder: In Afrikaans a tent is 'afgeslaan' (or opgeslaan); 'afhaal' is not the idiomatic verb for a tent.
toegepas.fout: 'afhaal' is not the idiomatic verb for taking down a tent.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'n Tent afslaan' is the fixed Afrikaans expression and the meaning (take down and carry along) is unchanged.

toegepas.voor: die eerste antwoord op min water
toegepas.na: die eerste antwoord op die gebrek aan water
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'antwoord op min water' is wooden; 'gebrek aan water' is the natural noun phrase after 'antwoord op'.
toegepas.fout: 'antwoord op min water' is wooden: 'min water' does not work as the object of 'antwoord op'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'die gebrek aan water' is the natural noun phrase for a water shortage and keeps the meaning of scarce water.

toegepas.voor: Siwa is 'n oase in die Sahara wat in die weste van Egipte lê.
toegepas.na: Siwa is 'n oase in die Sahara, in die weste van Egipte.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'wat' can be read as referring to the Sahara rather than Siwa; the apposition removes the ambiguity without changing the facts.
toegepas.fout: The relative clause 'wat in die weste van Egipte lê' can attach to 'die Sahara' instead of Siwa.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The apposition places Siwa in western Egypt without the ambiguity, is shorter, and adds or drops no fact.

na_skrywer.voor: 'n Palmboom met soet vrugte wat in warm plekke naby water groei.
na_skrywer.na: 'n Palmboom wat in warm plekke naby water groei en soet vrugte dra.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'wat' attaches to 'vrugte' rather than the palm; reordering makes the tree the thing that grows near water.
na_skrywer.fout: In the glossary definition 'wat in warm plekke naby water groei' can attach to 'vrugte' rather than to the palm.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The ambiguity is real, but this is a [begrip] definition that may be shared across lessons, so the reordering must go through the writer.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer
